scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-[var(--text-primary)]

rules: Use oxblood ONLY for CTA buttons, thin accent lines, and important icons. Never as large backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous whitespace. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers. Ensure mobile responsiveness.
layout_and_spacing.page_titles: Must have a thin oxblood accent line underneath (e.g., flex flex-col gap-2 with a border-b-2 border-oxblood w-16 or w-24 mb-8).
layout_and_spacing.header: Clean nav. 'Masuk Staff' renamed to 'Portal Staf', smaller button size (text-sm px-4 py-2), placed in the top right.

buttons.primary: bg-oxblood hover:bg-oxblood-hover text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-oxblood text-oxblood hover:bg-oxblood hover:text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors font-medium

cards.default: bg-card p-6 md:p-8 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-black/5

inputs.default: w-full bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-md px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-oxblood focus:border-transparent transition-shadow text-content

accordion.usage: Use for 'Ketentuan Pengajuan' to replace the 'CATATAN PENTING' panel.
accordion.style: bg-card border border-gray-200 rounded-md p-4 cursor-pointer flex justify-between items-center transition-colors hover:bg-gray-100

landing.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Left: Fraunces heading, thin oxblood line, CTAs. Right: Grand stone building image with soft rounded corners. High whitespace.
landing.sections: 'Cara Melacak Pengajuan' cards, 3 process steps in a clean grid (e.g. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8).

login_staff.layout: Split screen or large card layout. Left: Lady Justice image covering full height with a subtle overlay if needed. Right: Centered login form with high padding (p-12).

form_pengajuan_mahasiswa.layout: Single column form inside a large --bg-card, heavily padded. Multi-field grid for desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6).
form_pengajuan_mahasiswa.features: Collapsible 'Ketentuan Pengajuan' at the top or side. 'Panel bentrok/saran slot' dynamically shown with soft highlight.

cek_status.layout: Centered search box with oxblood search icon/button. Below, display booking status card.
cek_status.features: Status card includes details, log reschedule timeline, and action buttons (edit/batal/ajukan ulang) in secondary button styles.

image_urls.description: Grand stone building with arched windows for the Landing page hero section.
Lady justice statue with scales and sword for the Staff Login page left panel.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update CSS variables (like --bg-primary, --accent-oxblood, etc.) in the global CSS file.
Update tailwind.config.js to use these CSS variables.
Ensure headings use the Fraunces font and body uses the Inter font.
Do NOT change any logic, purely visual redesign based on these guidelines.
Make 'CATATAN PENTING' a collapsible accordion labeled 'Ketentuan Pengajuan ▾'.
Change 'Masuk Staff' to 'Portal Staf' and make it smaller in the header.
Add a thin oxblood accent line under page titles.
Ensure generous whitespace and mobile responsiveness.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
